memory_vector_check.name: memory_vector_check
memory_vector_check.value: ("memories"."embedding" is null and "memories"."dimensions" is null and "memories"."embedding_space" is null) or ("memories"."embedding" is not null and "memories"."dimensions" is not null and "memories"."embedding_space" is not null and vector_dims("memories"."embedding") = "memories"."dimensions" and "memories"."dimensions" between 1 and 4096)
